lines: Price opened inside value. This is where most traders lose money.
This is the P.O.C. The fair price, where most volume traded.
These are the V.A.H. and the V.A.L. The edges of value.
Inside value, price rotates. Watch it reach the top edge.
Big seller. Right at the V.A.H.
C.V.D. turns down. Buyers are exhausted.
No breakout. The target is the P.O.C.
Inside value, don't chase breakouts. Fade the edges.
